unpack_flux2_latents: unpack denoised latents using position IDs to scatter tokens into spatial layout
decode_flux2_latents: decode denoised latents into images using Flux2 VAE with batch norm denormalization
unpatchify_flux2_latents: convert patchified latents back to regular spatial format for the VAE decoder
run_flux2_unpack_step: run the Flux2UnpackLatentsStep pipeline block to unpack latents with position IDs
run_flux2_decode_step: run the Flux2DecodeStep pipeline block to decode latents into final images
